books.name: Prudent
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the Brent fund, never levered and never short. It is the book one could keep in an account without margin: it buys BNO when the forecast is long and stays in cash otherwise.
books.note: Brent ETF: holds the nearest ICE future and rolls it two weeks before the expiry.

last_decision.rationale: Prezzo +13,6, curva +0,0, altri mercati -3,3: previsione +6,0 su 20. Volatilità 41% contro un obiettivo del 12%: esposizione 0,17x. Compro 1 azioni di BNO: obiettivo 22 (long, 0,14x; al bordo della fascia di inerzia).

books.name: Dynamic
books.description: Half Kelly on the Brent fund, long and short. Long: BNO up to 2x on margin (the most Regulation T allows overnight). Short: it buys SCO, the fund that returns -2 times WTI each day, with cash and never beyond 100% of the account. The same forecast as the prudent book, twice the risk, and the short side too.
books.note: Brent ETF: holds the nearest ICE future and rolls it two weeks before the expiry.

rules.short_note: ETF that returns -2 times a WTI futures index each day: the book's short side is obtained by buying it with cash, and it cannot lose more than what is invested in it. Over several days its return is not -2 times the crude's (daily reset, 0.95% a year in fees).

last_decision.rationale: Prezzo +13,6, curva +0,0, altri mercati -3,3: previsione +6,0 su 20. Volatilità 41% contro un obiettivo del 25%: esposizione 0,36x. Compro 4 azioni di BNO: obiettivo 47 (long, 0,30x; al bordo della fascia di inerzia).

books.name: Aggressive
books.description: Full Kelly on the micro WTI future, long and short, up to 10x. The leverage is not chosen: it comes out of the ratio between the volatility target and the volatility of the moment. With crude at 50% volatility it stays between 1x and 2x; it takes calm markets and a strong forecast to see it rise. It can wipe out the account.
books.note: Robinhood has no Brent future: the linear leverage goes through WTI, with basis risk.

last_decision.rationale: Prezzo +10,3, curva +0,0, altri mercati -3,3: previsione +4,1 su 20. Volatilità 40% contro un obiettivo del 50%: esposizione 0,50x, meno di quanto serve per un lotto intero (100 barili): nessuna posizione su CLX26.

books.name: Options
books.description: Put credit spreads on USO (and on BNO when the quotes allow it), sold below the market when the forecast is long. Maximum loss defined at the opening: 5% of the account per structure, two structures at most. Experimental: the simulation is a model, the book exists to measure it on real prices.
books.robinhood: option spreads on USO and BNO (level 3)

books.name: Gold
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the gold fund, never levered and never short: the prudent book's rules, the forecast read on the price of gold itself. The market of geopolitics.
books.note: Gold fund: holds bullion in a vault, no roll and no curve; 0.40 % a year.

books.name: Copper
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the copper fund, never levered and never short: the prudent book's rules, the forecast read on the price of copper itself. The market of electrification and data centres.
books.note: Copper fund: holds COMEX copper futures along a rules-based curve position; thin, pays its spread.

books.name: Agriculture
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the agriculture fund (corn, soybeans, wheat, sugar, coffee, cocoa, livestock), never levered and never short: the prudent book's rules on the market the weather moves most.
books.note: Agriculture fund: corn, soybeans, wheat, sugar, coffee, cocoa, cattle and hogs futures, rolled on rules.

books.name: Treasuries
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on long Treasuries, never levered and never short: the market that pays when growth and inflation fall. Coupons credited on the ex-date.
books.note: Long Treasuries: a coupon a month, credited.

books.name: Equities
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the S&P 500, never levered and never short: a way of being in equities that steps aside in the declines, not a signal that anticipates them.
books.note: The S&P 500: the most liquid fund there is; dividends quarterly.

books.name: Uranium
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the uranium fund, never levered and never short: the nuclear leg of the electricity the data centres need.
books.note: Uranium miners and trusts: the nuclear leg of data-centre power; thin.

books.name: Utilities
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on US utilities, never levered and never short: the grid that carries the new electricity demand; moves with interest rates.
books.note: US utilities: the grid the new demand runs on; rate-sensitive.

books.name: Lithium
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the lithium and battery fund, never levered and never short: electrification, a boom-and-bust market the trend rule rides and leaves.
books.note: Lithium and batteries: electrification; boom and bust.

books.name: Semiconductors
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on semiconductors, never levered and never short: the AI investment itself. Shares two thirds of its moves with the S&P 500, so it counts for less than a separate market.
books.note: Semiconductors: the AI investment itself; 0.65 with SPY.

books.name: Clean energy
books.description: A quarter of Kelly on the clean energy fund (solar, wind, hydrogen), never levered and never short: the energy transition, which boomed in 2020 and bust after; the trend rule earned the boom and sat out the bust.
books.note: Solar, wind, hydrogen: boom in 2020, bust after.
